entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.213 of 2025 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C. (O) Bhubaneswar arising out of Pahala P.S. Case No.45 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420/34 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
4. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
5. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.

(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Designation: Senior Stenographer Location: High Court of Orissa,
